source: Graha Phala - Results of Planets in the 12 Houses (Astro Vaibhav Gupta) - standard Parashari cross-reference

Sun.1: Strong self-respect, authoritative, loves justice. Can be dominant. Soul Satisfaction: self-improvement, health.
Sun.2: Authoritative speech, makes sacrifices for family. Attracted to occult. Soul Satisfaction: supporting family, wealth creation.
Sun.3: Fame via communication, courageous, self-made. Sacrifices for siblings. Soul Satisfaction: writing, travel, supporting siblings.
Sun.4: Mother is individualistic. Can give Raj Yoga (govt. vehicles). May be away from home. Soul Satisfaction: acquiring comfort, vehicles, stable home.
Sun.5: High status, VIP connections. Sharp intellect. Sacrifices for children. Soul Satisfaction: teaching, advising, guiding children.
Sun.6: Dominates high-ranking enemies. Father in law/health. Weak immunity. Soul Satisfaction: healing others, resolving disputes.
Sun.7: Spouse has high self-respect. Ego clashes in relationships. Increases body heat (Pitta). Soul Satisfaction: public dealings, serving spouse.
Sun.8: Attracted to occult, research, astrology. Issues for father (12th from 9th). Soul Satisfaction: research, solving mysteries.
Sun.9: Highly religious, spiritual. Attached to father/guru. Good consultant. Soul Satisfaction: religious travel, service to guru.
Sun.10: Digbala (directional strength). Excellent for govt. jobs, authority. Passionate about work. Wants to be #1. Soul Satisfaction: acquiring status, professional recognition.
Sun.11: Strong position. Gains from father, large network. Accumulates great wealth. Soul Satisfaction: social networking, financial gains.
Sun.12: Prefers isolation, meditation. Success in hospitals, foreign lands. Charitable. Soul Satisfaction: isolation, meditation, charity.

Moon.1: Emotional, sensitive, attractive. Attracted to public/partners (7th). Focus: self-identity, social interaction.
Moon.2: Fluctuating wealth. Mind on savings/family. Attracted to occult/research (8th). Focus: financial security, hidden truths.
Moon.3: Strong imagination, writer, enjoys travel. Attracted to higher knowledge/gurus (9th). Focus: travel, communication, philosophy.
Moon.4: Seeks peace near water, attached to home. Attracted to career/status (10th). Focus: home comfort, professional standing.
Moon.5: Strong intuition, good for speculation. Attracted to gains/networks (11th). Focus: children, education, investments.
Moon.6: Mind drawn to service, details, auditing. Attracted to isolation/foreign lands (12th). Focus: service, resolving disputes.
Moon.7: Mind dominated by partner. Seeks public validation. Attracted to self-identity (1st). Focus: partner's happiness, public bonds.
Moon.8: Strong interest in occult, research. Prone to grudges. Attracted to wealth/finance (2nd). Focus: hidden knowledge, financial manipulation.
Moon.9: Mind on long travel, higher knowledge. Attracted to siblings/skills (3rd). Focus: philosophy, spiritual journeys.
Moon.10: Mind on career, reputation. Attracted to home/comfort (4th). Success in Moon-related fields. Focus: professional status, material comfort.
Moon.11: Mind fixed on profits, social networks. Attracted to children/speculation (5th). Fluctuating income. Focus: financial gain, investments.
Moon.12: Prefers isolation, meditation. Charitable. Attracted to service/conflict (6th). Focus: spiritual liberation, helping others.

Mars.1: Action-oriented, logical, fearless. A 'frontal attacker.' Prone to head injuries. Action: direct challenges, debate.
Mars.2: Straightforward speech (causes conflict). Money-minded, calculative. Income from Mars fields (property, fire). Action: accumulating wealth.
Mars.3: Brilliant Raj Yoga. Strong execution power. A 'sleeping lion' awakened by challenge. Action: execution of plans, sports.
Mars.4: Mentally restless at home, causes arguments. Acquires luxury/vehicles via effort. Action: acquiring property, leaving home.
Mars.5: Sharp, technical intellect (Math, Science). Deep researcher. Prone to stomach issues. Action: intellectual strategy, research, competition.
Mars.6: Raj Yoga. Overcomes enemies, wins competitions. Great for doctors, military. Action: service, winning, fitness.
Mars.7: Ego clashes in marriage ('Tom and Jerry'). Loyal but fiery. Raj Yoga for career/wealth. Action: professional growth, battles for partner.
Mars.8: A 'behind the scenes' strategist. Interest in occult. Prone to accidents. Action: deep research, solving mysteries, commission gains.
Mars.9: Logical skeptic, but a fierce protector of faith. Separation from father. Action: higher learning, long travel, defending beliefs.
Mars.10: Digbala/Exalted. Career is the battlefield. A leader, not a boss. Rapid fame. Action: high ambition, team leadership.
Mars.11: Raj Yoga. Multiple income sources, high financial success. Pursues desires relentlessly. Action: financial gain, aggressive networking.
Mars.12: Sacrificing nature, avoids show. Excellent subconscious writer. Prone to leg injuries. Action: self-sacrifice, creative writing, silent service.

Mercury.1: Appears youthful, charming. Highly analytical, but prone to overthinking. Needs constant validation.
Mercury.2: Excellent salesman, convincing speaker. Tracks finances precisely. Risk of lying for gain. Success after 34.
Mercury.3: High dexterity (writing, drawing, music). Unique voice. Enjoys travel. Must validate siblings.
Mercury.4: Excellent house manager, economical. Interest in interior/vehicle design. Mind is connected to home.
Mercury.5: Powerful convincing ability (manifests speech). Excellent for stock analysis. Success rises after 34.
Mercury.6: Wins with speech/wit (office politics). Good for law, auditing. Maternal uncle (Mama) is famous.
Mercury.7: Great business skills (expansion, development). Popular, but must avoid verbal arguments in marriage.
Mercury.8: Creates anxiety, fear, speech issues (stammering). Prone to OCD/depression. Avoid day trading.
Mercury.9: Questions religion, demands logic. Good for translation, journalism. Avoid unsolicited advice.
Mercury.10: Excellent manager, high speed. 'Jack of all trades.' Must update skills to avoid procrastination.
Mercury.11: Highly social, makes friends easily. Desires wealth via communication. Gain job experience before business.
Mercury.12: A dreamer, 'false promises' (says but doesn't do). Prone to procrastination. Avoid marriage before 25.

Jupiter.1: Wise, optimistic, magnetic. 5th aspect blesses children and wisdom. Merits: Personality itself.
Jupiter.2: Expands wealth and family. 5th aspect (to 6th) channels merits into service/healing. Good for finance/HR.
Jupiter.3: Good speaker/storyteller. 5th aspect (to 7th) blesses marriage. Spouse brings luck.
Jupiter.4: Exalted (Cancer). Blessed with home, comfort. 5th aspect (to 8th) channels merits into research/occult.
Jupiter.5: Wise, creative, natural counselor. 5th aspect (to 9th) blesses luck and father. Child brings fame.
Jupiter.6: Overcomes enemies/debts. 5th aspect (to 10th) blesses career. Child's birth brings promotion.
Jupiter.7: Wise, moral partner. 5th aspect (to 11th) blesses income/network. Partner brings expansion.
Jupiter.8: Interest in occult/research. 5th aspect (to 12th) channels merits into spirituality/charity.
Jupiter.9: Excellent for luck, morality. 5th aspect (to 1st) blesses self with wisdom. A natural Guru.
Jupiter.10: Career in teaching, law, consulting. 5th aspect (to 2nd) blesses wealth and family. Loud, impactful voice.
Jupiter.11: Excellent for wealth, friends. 5th aspect (to 3rd) blesses communication and skills.
Jupiter.12: Spiritual, meditative. 5th aspect (to 4th) blesses mental peace and home comfort (often abroad).

Venus.1: Charming, magnetic, attractive. Refined taste. Wealth from appearance (modeling, fitness).
Venus.2: Sweet, fine speech. Wealth from family. Source: banking, food, jewelry, or beauty products.
Venus.3: Artistic communication. Wealth from social media, writing, or luxury travel. Creative hobbies.
Venus.4: Blessed with comfort, property, vehicles. Wealth from real estate, transport, or home luxury.
Venus.5: Artistic, charming, intelligent. Wealth from teaching, entertainment, or speculation. Gains after childbirth.
Venus.6: Wealth from service, law, health. Must be cautious of Venus-related health issues (kidneys).
Venus.7: Partner is wealthy or brings prosperity. Wealth from partnership, business, or public dealings.
Venus.8: Inheritance or sudden, unearned wealth. Wealth from insurance, research, or commissions.
Venus.9: Auspicious, born into wealth. Wealth from teaching, consulting, or foreign travel. Lucky partner.
Venus.10: Fame and status. Wealth from luxury goods, fashion, vehicles, or entertainment. Prone to office politics.
Venus.11: Powerful Dhana Yoga. Multiple income streams. Wealth from social networks, large organizations.
Venus.12: Exalted (Pisces). Charitable, spiritual. Rule: wealth increases with expenditure. Success in foreign lands.

Saturn.1: Serious, mature, disciplined. Delays in recognition. 3rd aspect on 3rd brings success via self-effort.
Saturn.2: Learns value of money via scarcity. Slow, stable savings. 10th aspect on 11th gives gains from hard work.
Saturn.3: Patience and endurance to learn skills. 3rd aspect on 5th gives mature intellect (good for teaching).
Saturn.4: Lack of emotional comfort, separation from mother. 10th aspect on 1st forces self-reliance.
Saturn.5: Delay in children/education. Serious, mature intellect (Math, Admin). Avoid speculation.
Saturn.6: Excellent position. Defeats enemies slowly. Success in service, law, health. Meticulous worker.
Saturn.7: Exalted (Libra). Delay in marriage, but gives a disciplined/older partner. 10th aspect on 4th brings stability.
Saturn.8: Excellent for longevity. Deep researcher (occult, insurance). 3rd aspect on 10th gives steady career.
Saturn.9: Traditional, serious about religion. Distance from father. 10th aspect on 6th gives victory in service.
Saturn.10: Excellent for authority. Slow, steady climb. 7th aspect on 4th stabilizes home through career.
Saturn.11: Powerful Dhana Yoga. Gains are slow but consistent. Limited, loyal friends. 3rd aspect on 1st gives resilience.
Saturn.12: Success in foreign lands, exports, or isolated service (NGOs). 10th aspect on 9th brings traditional faith.

Rahu.1: Obsessed with fame, power, and self-identity. Wants to be center of attention. Harms father's health.
Rahu.2: Sudden gains, manipulative speech. Obsessed with quick wealth. Harms Jupiter's karakas (children, guru).
Rahu.3: Extreme courage, self-made. Success in marketing, social media. Harms Mars's karakas (siblings).
Rahu.4: Obsessed with mother, home, luxury. Chaotic home. Strong potential for foreign settlement.
Rahu.5: Obsession with speculation, fame, power (Sun/Leo). Good for politics, entertainment. Issues with children.
Rahu.6: Massive loan, but ability to pay off. Overcomes high-status enemies. Success in law, health, auditing.
Rahu.7: Partner from a different culture/caste. Intense desire in relationships. Risk of cheating in business.
Rahu.8: Obsessed with occult, research, tantra. Potential for sudden gains/inheritance. Prone to anxiety.
Rahu.9: Obsession with foreign travel, global philosophy. May have a foreign guru. Risk of misfortune at religious places.
Rahu.10: Sudden fame, power. Unconventional career (tech, media, politics). High desire for status.
Rahu.11: Powerful Dhana Yoga. Amplifies all desires and financial gains. Success via large networks, social media.
Rahu.12: Inclined to spiritual exploration, foreign lands. Prone to weird dreams, anxiety, sudden expenses.

Ketu.1: Ego-less, intuitive. A 'Trouble Shooter' for others. 2nd house (family/wealth) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.2: Healer for others' financial/dental issues. Detached from family wealth. 3rd house (siblings) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.3: Excellent dexterity (writing, art). Orator. 4th house (home/mother) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.4: Emotional healer. Lives on top floor or near a temple. 5th house (children/love) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.5: Strong intuition (Mantra Shakti). Natural counselor. 6th house (routine/health) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.6: Excellent for work (Doctor, Lawyer). Liberates others from disease/debt. 7th house (marriage) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.7: Astrologer/Counselor for others' relationships. Detached from partner. 8th house (inheritance) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.8: Extreme intuition, psychic. Deep spiritual practice. 9th house (father/guru) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.9: Deeply blessed (divine help). Decodes religious texts. 10th house (career/status) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.10: Performs Nishkam Karma (action without desire). Works in unconventional fields. 11th house (gains) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.11: Deep researcher, private social circle. High drive for innovation. 12th house (spirituality) sees dissatisfaction.
Ketu.12: Most meditative and spiritual (Moksha). 1st house (self/ego) sees dissatisfaction. Final liberation.
